brief: Global sentiment is recovering, with Wall Street posting its best session since April last year and Nasdaq futures up 3% after Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO, while Asian stocks rallied. Indian shares are coming off a sharp bank-led sell-off that ended a four-week rally, so the open may be firmer but remains fragile.
